name: Taskade
tagline: AI workspace for tasks, projects, and multi-agent automated workflows.
description: Taskade turns prompts into apps, AI agents, and automated workflows in one workspace, blending task lists, projects, notes, and mind maps with real-time collaboration. Its AI agents handle research, writing, and reviewing with multi-agent handoffs, plus durable automations and 100+ integrations.
insight: It blends a classic outliner/task workspace with no-code multi-agent teams, so one doc is both a project plan and where agents execute it.

modelSupport.notes: Agents can run on multiple frontier model providers.
